cds.title: Penn State Abington Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF)

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set, Penn State Abington campus only, fall 2025 entering class (residency split as printed; totals check: in-state + out-of-state + international = total). No early decision; early action closes 11/01 with notification 12/24; no application closing date, rolling. Enrollment: 2,710 undergraduates, 151 nonresident undergraduates. International first-years: 789 applied, 731 admitted (93%), 49 enrolled. SAT/ACT optional (considered if submitted); score percentiles are for the 130 enrolled SAT submitters (ACT: only 9 students). The GPA breakdown is the 'all enrolled students' column.

cds_test_policy.notes: Common Data Set: SAT/ACT not required for admission, but considered if submitted.

cost.notes: First-year costs from the Common Data Set (2026-27), Penn State Abington campus: tuition in-state $14,684, out-of-state/nonresident $25,584 (international students pay the nonresident rate); required fees $630; food and housing $12,786 as printed (housing $10,786 + food $2,000; the estimate for students living off campus is $18,276); books $1,290; other costs = transportation $2,244 + other expenses $3,112. Tuition varies by program. The college's own scholarship and grant aid is not available to nonresident undergraduates
